{{Quote|We should be impacting the city in one-five-zero seconds. I hope you have enjoyed your ride with Calamari Shuttles &mdash;|A shuttle autopilot|<ref name="Death in the Undercity">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>}}
'''Calamari Shuttles''' was an organization that operated [[Autopilot/Legends|automated]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] that transported visitors from an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] station to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]]. One of the shuttles they operated was designated [[Ex-Eighty-Nine]].
